items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gene Roland wrote a few things for him

ctx.x: George Russell wrote a few things for him, Gene Roland wrote a few things for him, Eddie Sauter wrote some things for him. I can’t remember if Al wrote anything or not, but he was sure in the band.
I heard recordings of, there’s the one CD that came out in ‘89 that had never been released before and I heard three charts of yours; one called, “Krazy Kat.”
